cards.details: Rise of the three great kingdoms: Cheras, Cholas, and Pandyas in the Tamilakam region.
Era of the great Sangam academies and flourishing of classical Tamil literature (Ettuthogai, Pattupattu).
The Kalabhra Interregnum marks the end of the classical Sangam period.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing 'Sangam' as a religious body; it was a literary assembly of poets.
Assuming the Varna system existed as strictly as in North India; it was distinct with caste-like groups (kudi).
Overlooking the role of 'Hero Stones' (Viragals) in social honor.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography (Tinai)

  • Kurinji: Hills
  • Mullai: Pastoral
  • Marudam: Riverine
  • Neythal: Coastal
  • Palai: Arid

Social Structure

  • Vellar: Farmers
  • Panar: Bards
  • Kallar: Warriors
  • Brahmins: Scholars/Priests

Social and Economic Mindmap

  • Economic Life
    • Agriculture: Primary base (Marudam).
    • Trade: Massive maritime trade with Romans (Arikamedu).
    • Crafts: Weaving, pearl fishery, and bead making.
  • Social Stratification
    • Absence of rigid Varna, but presence of 'Kudi' (social groups).
    • Status of Women: Generally free, but Sati existed.
    • Role of Bards: Panars played a vital role in royal courts.
